title: Skill amendments gated on observed evidence
objective: Require focused scope, observed failure or user-feedback evidence, examples/reference-set coverage, validation commands, and publication safety before a skill amendment can be promoted.
source_rule: Evidence before edits: no skill amendment without an observed failure or reference-set gap.
allowed_evidence: observed skill-run failure or user-feedback excerpts
reference-set gap analysis against existing skills
forbidden_actions: promoting a skill rewrite without examples, validation, or observed failure evidence
adding broad multi-domain skills that duplicate existing focused skills
copying private operator context, secrets, tokens, or personal paths into skills
claiming a skill-quality improvement without a reference set or regression command
acceptance_gates: changed skill or guidance surface is named
observed failure, user feedback, or reference-set gap is recorded
example or regression evidence is attached
